pairs.target: shào píng chī wán bǐng , xiān qù ménbiān qǔhuí dùhéng xièxià de diàosuǒ .
pairs.english: After finishing the flatbread, Shao Ping first went to the gateway to retrieve the hauling line Du Heng had set down.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平吃完饼，先去门边取回杜衡卸下的吊索。

pairs.target: dùhéng jiēguò qù , chóngxīn guà zài bèináng shàng , shēnshǒu gěi tā tuō le yìbǎ héngmù .
pairs.english: Du Heng took it, hung it on his pack again, and reached out to help lift the crossbar for him.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡接过去，重新挂在背囊上，伸手给他托了一把横木。

pairs.target: wēn shù zhāixià yóudēng , hélǒng dēng gài .
pairs.english: Wen Shu took down the oil lamp and closed its cover.
pairs.hanzi: 温述摘下油灯，合拢灯盖。

pairs.target: zhòngrén zhàn qǐlái shí , xǔ cén yǐjīng bǎ zhǐ zhé hǎo , yāzhù xīntiān de nà yìjiǎo , dìgěi shěn yàn zhōu .
pairs.english: As everyone stood, Xu Cen had already folded the sheet, flattening the newly marked corner before passing it to Shen Yanzhou.
pairs.hanzi: 众人站起来时，许岑已经把纸折好，压住新添的那一角，递给沈砚舟。

pairs.target: " zuǒbiān rào .
pairs.english: “Round to the left.
pairs.hanzi: “左边绕。

pairs.target: dào dìèrdào duàn qiáng zài wǎng xià , bǐ yòubiān duō zǒu yìchéng . "
pairs.english: Down again at the second broken wall; it's a longer walk than the right-hand route.”
pairs.hanzi: 到第二道断墙再往下，比右边多走一程。”

pairs.target: " néng bèizhe guò me ? "
pairs.english: “Can we get through with the frames on?”
pairs.hanzi: “能背着过么？”

pairs.target: shào píng wèn .
pairs.english: Shao Ping asked.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平问。

pairs.target: xǔ cén kàn le yìyǎn tā de bèi jià .
pairs.english: Xu Cen glanced at his carrying frame.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑看了一眼他的背架。

pairs.target: " rén néng guò .
pairs.english: “A person can get through.
pairs.hanzi: “人能过。

pairs.target: dōngxī héng zhe ná . "
pairs.english: Carry the loads crosswise.”
pairs.hanzi: 东西横着拿。”

pairs.target: lín zhào gēnzhe tāmen zǒu dào zhùláng jìntóu , cái míngbái zhèhuà de yìsī .
pairs.english: Only when Lin Zhao followed them to the end of the colonnade did she understand what that meant.
pairs.hanzi: 林照跟着他们走到柱廊尽头，才明白这话的意思。

pairs.target: lù hái lián zhe , zhuǎnjiǎochù què tāxià yíkuài shíbì , xié xié dì kǎ zài qiánggēn , zhī liúxià yídào zhǎi fèng .
pairs.english: The path was still connected, but a slab of wall had collapsed at the corner and lodged diagonally against its base, leaving only a narrow gap.
pairs.hanzi: 路还连着，转角处却塌下一块石壁，斜斜地卡在墙根，只留下一道窄缝。

pairs.target: kōng zhe shēn cè guòqù bìng bùnán , bèi jiàshàng de tóngguō què bǐ jiānbǎng kuān chū yì jié .
pairs.english: Turning sideways through it unladen was easy enough, but the copper pot on the frame stuck out wider than her shoulders.
pairs.hanzi: 空着身侧过去并不难，背架上的铜锅却比肩膀宽出一截。

pairs.target: shào píng méi jiě shéng , xiān jiāng bèi jià xièxià , dìgěi zhàn zài lìngyìbiān de dùhéng .
pairs.english: Without untying the rope, Shao Ping first unloaded his frame and passed it to Du Heng on the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平没解绳，先将背架卸下，递给站在另一边的杜衡。

pairs.target: dùhéng xié zhe táiguòqù , děng tā zuàn chū zhǎi fèng , zài tì tā fú hǎo .
pairs.english: Du Heng lifted it across at an angle, then helped him settle it once he had squeezed through the gap.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡斜着抬过去，等他钻出窄缝，再替他扶好。

pairs.target: lún dào lín zhào , tā yě zhàoyàng xiè le , guòqù shí shǒulǐ kōngkōng de , dǎo yǒuxiē bú guàn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao's turn came; she also unloaded in the same way, and as she crossed with nothing in her hands, it felt a little strange.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到林照，她也照样卸了，过去时手里空空的，倒有些不惯。

pairs.target: xǔ cén yǐjīng wǎngqiánzǒu .
pairs.english: Xu Cen was already walking ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑已经往前走。

pairs.target: tā de yījiǎo cā guò shíbì , méiyǒu zhān dào nà piàn chuíluò de shī tái .
pairs.english: Her hem brushed the stone wall without touching the wet moss hanging down.
pairs.hanzi: 她的衣角擦过石壁，没有沾到那片垂落的湿苔。

pairs.target: wǎng xià de lù bǐlín zhào yǐwéi de cháng .
pairs.english: The way down was longer than Lin Zhao had expected.
pairs.hanzi: 往下的路比林照以为的长。

pairs.target: tāmen chuānguò liǎngchù lùtiān de xiǎoyuàn , yòu ràoguò yìpái zhī shèng bànjié de mén .
pairs.english: They crossed two small open-air courtyards, then went around a row of gateways only half left standing.
pairs.hanzi: 他们穿过两处露天的小院，又绕过一排只剩半截的门。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān de qiáng yuèláiyuè gāo , qiángjiǎo què yǒu xǔduō xiǎo dòng , shuǐ cóng dòng lǐ xìxìdì liú chūlái , huìjìn lùpáng de shígōu .
pairs.english: The wall on the left grew taller and taller, but many little holes dotted its foot; water trickled gently out of them into the stone gutter beside the path.
pairs.hanzi: 左边的墙越来越高，墙脚却有许多小洞，水从洞里细细地流出来，汇进路旁的石沟。

pairs.target: lín zhào měi zǒu yíduàn , biàn dé huàn yìbiān fú bēidài , ěr páng shǐzhōng yǒu shuǐshēng , shí jìn shí yuǎn , gé zhe qiáng , tīngbùchū jiūjìng tōngxiàng nǎér .
pairs.english: Each stretch Lin Zhao walked meant switching the hand supporting the strap; the sound of water was always in her ears, now near, now far beyond the wall, and she could not tell where it ultimately led.
pairs.hanzi: 林照每走一段，便得换一边扶背带，耳旁始终有水声，时近时远，隔着墙，听不出究竟通向哪儿。

pairs.target: jīngguò dìsāngè ménkǒu shí , qī lán tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: As she passed the third doorway, Qi Lan paused.
pairs.hanzi: 经过第三个门口时，戚岚停了一下。

pairs.target: tā bǎ gōng dìgěi shěn yàn zhōu , zìjǐ tàshàng cèbiān yíkuài gāo shí , cháo mén hòu wànglewàng .
pairs.english: She handed her bow to Shen Yanzhou, stepped onto a high stone at the side herself, and peered beyond the doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 她把弓递给沈砚舟，自己踏上侧边一块高石，朝门后望了望。

pairs.target: lín zhào zhī kànjiàn yì jié qīngdǎo de shízuò , zuò páng yǒu zhī xiǎo wǎn , wǎnkǒu quē le , fù shàng què hái liú zhe jǐméi hēisè bǔdīng , yán yídào jiù lièfèng pái dé hěn qí .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao saw only a toppled stone base and a little bowl beside it; its rim was chipped, yet several black repair staples still remained on its body, neatly lined along an old crack.
pairs.hanzi: 林照只看见一截倾倒的石座，座旁有只小碗，碗口缺了，腹上却还留着几枚黑色补钉，沿一道旧裂缝排得很齐。

pairs.target: tā bùyóudé duō kàn le liǎngyǎn .
pairs.english: She could not help looking again.
pairs.hanzi: 她不由得多看了两眼。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn yě yǒu zhī bǔguò de wǎn , shèng rètāng shí zǒng ná bù diàn zhe dǐ .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou had a repaired bowl too, always padding its base with cloth when serving hot soup.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶也有只补过的碗，盛热汤时总拿布垫着底。

pairs.target: qī lán xià le shítou , qǔhuí gōng , yáo le yáotóu .
pairs.english: Qi Lan stepped down from the stone, took back her bow, and shook her head.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚下了石头，取回弓，摇了摇头。

pairs.target: yìxíng rén biàn jìxù wǎngqián .
pairs.english: Then the party continued on.
pairs.hanzi: 一行人便继续往前。

pairs.target: zài guò yíduàn , zhùláng hūrán xiàng wài zhǎnkāi .
pairs.english: A little farther on, the colonnade suddenly opened outward.
pairs.hanzi: 再过一段，柱廊忽然向外展开。

pairs.target: lín zhào gāng màichū yīnyǐng , yǎnqián biàn kōngkuò qǐlái .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao had just stepped out of the shadows when the view before her opened wide.
pairs.hanzi: 林照刚迈出阴影，眼前便空阔起来。

pairs.target: láng wài shì yízuò xiàn dé hěn shēn de tíngyuàn , jīshuǐ tūnmò le dǐxià jǐjí táijiē , jǐchù hēiqūqū de shídǐng cóng shuǐ lǐ lùchū lái , yuǎnchù háiyǒu dào duàn gǒng , bànbiān chuí zhe cū téng .
pairs.english: Beyond the gallery lay a deep sunken courtyard; standing water swallowed several lower steps, black stone tops protruded from the water here and there, and farther off stood a broken arch, thick vines trailing over one side.
pairs.hanzi: 廊外是一座陷得很深的庭院，积水吞没了底下几级台阶，几处黑黢黢的石顶从水里露出来，远处还有道断拱，半边垂着粗藤。

pairs.target: yǔ yǐjīng xiǎo le , xìxìde shuǐwén què búduàn cháo jìnchù yuàn jiǎo jù qù , zuānjìn yídào dī gǒng xià .
pairs.english: The rain had eased, yet fine ripples kept converging toward the near corner of the courtyard, slipping beneath a low arch.
pairs.hanzi: 雨已经小了，细细的水纹却不断朝近处院角聚去，钻进一道低拱下。

pairs.target: " bié kào quēkǒu . "
pairs.english: “Don't go near the gap,”
pairs.hanzi: “别靠缺口。”

pairs.target: dùhéng shuō .
pairs.english: Du Heng said.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡说。

pairs.target: lín zhào shōuzhù jiǎo .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 林照收住脚。

pairs.target: miànqián zhè duàn shílán duàn le , zhī shèng liǎnggè ǎi dūn , shuǐshēng cóng dǐxià yǒngshànglái , bǐ fāngcái géqiáng tīngjiàn de hòu dé duō .
pairs.english: The stone railing before her was broken, leaving only two low stumps; the water's roar rose from below, far fuller than what she had heard through the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 面前这段石栏断了，只剩两个矮墩，水声从底下涌上来，比方才隔墙听见的厚得多。

pairs.target: tā wǎng hòutuì , cái kànjiàn láng dǐng hái zài , kào nèi yǒu dào néng guānshàng de shímén , pángbiān de zhǎi jiē yě méi tā .
pairs.english: She stepped back; only then did she see that the gallery roof remained, with a closable stone door farther in and narrow steps beside it still intact.
pairs.hanzi: 她往后退，才看见廊顶还在，靠内有道能关上的石门，旁边的窄阶也没塌。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu hé dùhéng fēntóu chá guòmén hòu , wēn shù tídēng zhào le zhào shífèng , xǔ cén zài láng kǒu dūnxià , jiāng zhǐ fù àn zài yíkuài cán shí shàng .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou and Du Heng split up to check behind the door; Wen Shu lifted the lamp to inspect the cracks, while Xu Cen crouched at the gallery entrance and pressed her fingertips against a broken stone.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟和杜衡分头查过门后，温述提灯照了照石缝，许岑在廊口蹲下，将指腹按在一块残石上。

pairs.target: yíxiàn dàn bái cóng tā zhǐ xià liàng qǐ .
pairs.english: A thread of pale white shone from beneath her fingertips.
pairs.hanzi: 一线淡白从她指下亮起。

pairs.target: " zhèbiān liú yígè .
pairs.english: “I'll leave one here.
pairs.hanzi: “这边留一个。

pairs.target: huàngǎng shí jiào wǒ . "
pairs.english: Call me when the watch changes.”
pairs.hanzi: 换岗时叫我。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán qǐshēn , lín zhào cái fāxiàn , zìjǐ yòu kàn dé wàng le nuó jiǎo .
pairs.english: She finished speaking and rose; only then did Lin Zhao realize that once again she had stared so hard she had forgotten to move.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完起身，林照才发现，自己又看得忘了挪脚。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu kàn le kàn tiānsè .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou glanced at the sky.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟看了看天色。

pairs.target: " jīnwǎn jiù zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: “Here for tonight.
pairs.hanzi: “今晚就这里。

pairs.target: xiān bǎ dōngxī xiè le , tiānhēi búxià . "
pairs.english: Unload the gear first; we're not going down after dark.”
pairs.hanzi: 先把东西卸了，天黑不下。”

pairs.target: tīngjiàn zhè jù , lín zhào jiānshàng nàgēn lè le xǔjiǔ de dàizǐ , fǎngfú xiān sōng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Hearing that, Lin Zhao felt as if the strap that had bitten into her shoulder for so long had already loosened a little.
pairs.hanzi: 听见这句，林照肩上那根勒了许久的带子，仿佛先松了一点。

pairs.target: liǎngfù bèi jià bìngpái kào zàinèi qiáng , pūgài fàngdào gāochù , gānliáng nuó dào mén hòu .
pairs.english: The two frames leaned side by side against the inner wall; bedding went up high, provisions behind the door.
pairs.hanzi: 两副背架并排靠在内墙，铺盖放到高处，干粮挪到门后。

pairs.target: shào píng zài shílán quēkǒu liǎngbiān gè bǎng yídào shéng , dǎyǎn biàn néng kànjiàn ; dùhéng cóng pángbiān bān lái liǎngkuài suìshí , yāzhù shéng jiǎo .
pairs.english: Shao Ping tied a separate rope on either side of the gap in the railing, where it could easily be seen; Du Heng brought two chunks of stone from nearby to weigh down the rope ends.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平在石栏缺口两边各绑一道绳，打眼便能看见；杜衡从旁边搬来两块碎石，压住绳脚。

pairs.target: lín zhào qǔchū tóngguō , mō jiàn guō yán de bāo bù hái zài , biàn jiāng bù jiě xiàlái , liàng zài gān shí shàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao took out the copper pot, felt that the padding around its rim was still there, untied the cloth, and spread it on dry stone.
pairs.hanzi: 林照取出铜锅，摸见锅沿的包布还在，便将布解下来，晾在干石上。

pairs.target: wēn shù jiēguò shuǐnáng , wǎng guō lǐ dǎoshuǐ .
pairs.english: Wen Shu took the water skin and poured water into the pot.
pairs.hanzi: 温述接过水囊，往锅里倒水。

pairs.target: " dàilái de xiān yòng .
pairs.english: “Use what we brought first.
pairs.hanzi: “带来的先用。

pairs.target: dǐxià de shuǐ hái méi shì , bié tú shěngshì . "
pairs.english: The water below hasn't been tested yet; don't take the easy way.”
pairs.hanzi: 底下的水还没试，别图省事。”

pairs.target: lín zhàoyìng le yìshēng , bǎ zìjǐ de xiǎo shuǐnáng fàngdào pūgài páng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao answered and put her own small water skin beside the bedding.
pairs.hanzi: 林照应了一声，把自己的小水囊放到铺盖旁。

pairs.target: tái bèi jià shí tā hái juéde yǒujìn , zhēn máng qǐlái , cái zhīdào tuǐ yǐjīng suān le , dūnxiàqù zhǎo gè dōngxī , biàn bú dà yuànyì qǐlái .
pairs.english: She had still felt strong while lifting the frame, but once busy with camp chores, only then did she realize her legs already ached; after crouching to look for something, she hardly wanted to get up again.
pairs.hanzi: 抬背架时她还觉得有劲，真忙起来，才知道腿已经酸了，蹲下去找个东西，便不大愿意起来。

pairs.target: děng guōdǐ mào chū xì pào , tóudǐng de huī guāng yě àn le .
pairs.english: By the time tiny bubbles rose from the pot's bottom, the gray light overhead had dimmed too.
pairs.hanzi: 等锅底冒出细泡，头顶的灰光也暗了。

pairs.target: qī lán zuòzài ménbiān cā jiàn , cā guò yìzhī biàn gē dào lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: Qi Lan sat by the door wiping arrows; after each one was cleaned, she then laid it on the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚坐在门边擦箭，擦过一支便搁到另一边。

pairs.target: xǔ cén kàozhe zhé hǎo de pīyī , fānkàn túzhǐ , ǒuěr xiàng shěn yàn zhōu wèn yíjù .
pairs.english: Leaning against her folded cloak, Xu Cen studied the map and occasionally asked Shen Yanzhou a question.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑靠着折好的披衣，翻看图纸，偶尔向沈砚舟问一句。

pairs.target: tā dūn zài huǒpén páng tiān tàn , xiùkǒu cèng shàng le yìdiǎn báihuī , yě méi qù pāi .
pairs.english: He crouched beside the brazier adding charcoal; a little white ash smudged his cuff, and he did not brush it off.
pairs.hanzi: 他蹲在火盆旁添炭，袖口蹭上了一点白灰，也没去拍。

pairs.target: shào píng bǎ pūgài zhǎnpíng , hūrán cháo tā wèn : " gōngzǐ , fāng guǎnshì shuō , nín yào gǎi wùzī xíng de qì ? "
pairs.english: Shao Ping spread his bedding flat, then suddenly asked him, “Young master, Steward Fang says you mean to revise the supply firm's contract?”
pairs.hanzi: 邵平把铺盖展平，忽然朝他问：“公子，方管事说，您要改物资行的契？”

pairs.target: lín zhào shǒushàng yídùn , shùqǐ ěrduo .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao's hands paused; she pricked up her ears.
pairs.hanzi: 林照手上一顿，竖起耳朵。

pairs.target: " hái zài yì . "
pairs.english: “Still being discussed.”
pairs.hanzi: “还在议。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu bō le bō tàn , " nǐ tīng de shì nǎyìtiáo ? "
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou nudged the charcoal. “Which provision did you hear about?”
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟拨了拨炭，“你听的是哪一条？”

pairs.target: " shuō bānyùn de yě néng fēn gǔ . "
pairs.english: “They say porters can have shares too.”
pairs.hanzi: “说搬运的也能分股。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu jiāng huǒqián gē dào yìpáng .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou set the fire tongs to one side.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟将火钳搁到一旁。

pairs.target: " shào shīfu , wǒ xiān wèn yíjù .
pairs.english: “Master Shao, let me ask you something first.
pairs.hanzi: “邵师傅，我先问一句。

pairs.target: nǐmen rújīn jiēhuó , jiàqián zěnme dìng ? "
pairs.english: When you take jobs these days, how is the rate set?”
pairs.hanzi: 你们如今接活，价钱怎么定？”

pairs.target: " xíng lǐ yǒu jià .
pairs.english: “The firm has its rates.
pairs.hanzi: “行里有价。

pairs.target: zhēn lǐngdào duōshǎo , hái dé kàn shuí pài de huó . "
pairs.english: What you actually get still depends on who assigns the job.”
pairs.hanzi: 真领到多少，还得看谁派的活。”

pairs.target: " zhàng shàng bú duì , zhǎo shuí ? "
pairs.english: “If the account's wrong, who do you go to?”
pairs.hanzi: “账上不对，找谁？”

pairs.target: " xiān zhǎo lǐng wǒmen qù de rén .
pairs.english: “First go to the person who took us there.
pairs.hanzi: “先找领我们去的人。

pairs.target: nà tóu bú rèn , jiù zài zhǎo guǎnshì . "
pairs.english: If they won't acknowledge it, go to the steward next.”
pairs.hanzi: 那头不认，就再找管事。”

pairs.target: " néng gǎihuílái me ? "
pairs.english: “Can you get it corrected?”
pairs.hanzi: “能改回来么？”

pairs.target: shào píng xiào le yíxià .
pairs.english: Shao Ping smiled a little.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平笑了一下。

pairs.target: " gǎi dé huílái , xiàhuí yě wèibì yǒu huó .
pairs.english: “Even if you get it corrected, there may not be a job next time.
pairs.hanzi: “改得回来，下回也未必有活。

alignment.english: Even if you get it corrected

pairs.target: zǒng bùnéng huí huí dōu wèi jǐgè qián gēn rén mó . "
pairs.english: You can't haggle with people every single time over a few coins.”
pairs.hanzi: 总不能回回都为几个钱跟人磨。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu méi jiē huà , dītóu kàn le kàn shí yán shàng de huǒqián .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou did not reply, but looked down at the fire tongs on the stone edge.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟没接话，低头看了看石沿上的火钳。

pairs.target: tā kàn xiàng lín zhào .
pairs.english: He looked toward Lin Zhao.
pairs.hanzi: 他看向林照。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě pèng guò zhèyàng de shì ? "
pairs.english: “Have you run into that sort of thing too?”
pairs.hanzi: “你也碰过这样的事？”

pairs.target: tā méi liàodào huì wèn zìjǐ , shǒulǐ nà kuài bù zuàn jǐn le xiē .
pairs.english: She hadn't expected to be asked, and tightened her grip a little on the cloth in her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 她没料到会问自己，手里那块布攥紧了些。

pairs.target: " yǒushí búshì shǎo gěi .
pairs.english: “Sometimes it's not that they pay less.
pairs.hanzi: “有时不是少给。

pairs.target: shuōhǎo xiè yíchù , dào le yòu jiào wǎng lǐ bān , mòliǎo hái zhào yuánxiān suàn . "
pairs.english: They agree on unloading at one spot, then tell you to carry it farther in once you get there, and still pay the original rate at the end.”
pairs.hanzi: 说好卸一处，到了又叫往里搬，末了还照原先算。”

pairs.target: " duō zǒu nà yíduàn , méi rén jì ? "
pairs.english: “Nobody records the extra distance you carry it?”
pairs.hanzi: “多走那一段，没人记？”

pairs.target: " jì le yě méiyòng .
pairs.english: “It does no good even if they do.
pairs.hanzi: “记了也没用。

pairs.target: shōuhuò de zhī rèn tā de piào . "
pairs.english: The receiver only goes by his own delivery slip.”
pairs.hanzi: 收货的只认他的票。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu dītóu xiǎng le xiǎng , shēnshǒu xiàng xǔ cén yào guò yìzhāng kōng zhǐ hé bǐ , xiě le jǐzì .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou lowered his head in thought, then reached over to ask Xu Cen for a blank sheet of paper and a pen, and wrote a few words.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟低头想了想，伸手向许岑要过一张空纸和笔，写了几字。

pairs.target: " jiā huó dé lìngjì , liǎngtóu qiān rèn .
pairs.english: “Extra work needs its own record, with both sides signing it.
pairs.hanzi: “加活得另记，两头签认。

pairs.target: zhè tiáo wǒ huíqù tiān shàng . "
pairs.english: I'll add that provision when I get back.”
pairs.hanzi: 这条我回去添上。”

pairs.target: lín zhào wàng zhe tā luòbǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao watched him write.
pairs.hanzi: 林照望着他落笔。

pairs.target: tā yuányǐwéi wèn wán biàn guòqù le , dǎo méixiǎngdào tā zhēn yào jì .
pairs.english: She had thought he would simply let it drop after asking; she hadn't expected him to actually write it down.
pairs.hanzi: 她原以为问完便过去了，倒没想到他真要记。

pairs.target: " fēn gǔ de shì , wǒ xiǎng ràng huò duì , xiǎoduì , zuò bānyùn de dōu liú yífèn .
pairs.english: “About shares, I want caravans, expedition teams and porters all to keep a stake.
pairs.hanzi: “分股的事，我想让货队、小队、做搬运的都留一份。

pairs.target: bù zhī lǐng gōngqián , xíng lǐ de jìnchū zhàng yě gāi kàn dédào . "
pairs.english: They shouldn't just draw wages; they should be able to see the firm's money coming in and going out too.”
pairs.hanzi: 不只领工钱，行里的进出账也该看得到。”

alignment.english: money coming in and going out

pairs.target: shào píng jiāng pūgài biānshàng yìkē shízǐ kōu le chūqù .
pairs.english: Shao Ping pried out a little stone from beside his bedding.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平将铺盖边上一颗石子抠了出去。

pairs.target: " nà kuīle , yě suàn wǒmen yífèn ? "
pairs.english: “Then if there's a loss, we get a share of that too?”
pairs.hanzi: “那亏了，也算我们一份？”

pairs.target: " suàn .
pairs.english: “You do.

pairs.target: suǒyǐ dān duōshǎo , zěnme tuì , dōu dé xiān xiě míngbái , bùnéng zhī shuō zhuànqián shí yǒu nǐmen . "
pairs.english: That's why the liability and the way out both have to be written down clearly first; we can't just say you're included when there's a profit.”
pairs.hanzi: 所以担多少、怎么退，都得先写明白，不能只说赚钱时有你们。”

pairs.target: " kànjiàn zhàng , wèibì shuōdéshàng huà . "
pairs.english: “Seeing the accounts doesn't necessarily give you a say,”
pairs.hanzi: “看见账，未必说得上话。”

pairs.target: shào píng shuō , " zuìhòu háishì guǎnzhàng de rén dìng . "
pairs.english: Shao Ping said. “In the end, it's still the bookkeeper who decides.”
pairs.hanzi: 邵平说，“最后还是管账的人定。”

pairs.target: " nà jiù dé yǒu nǐmen zìjǐ tuī de rén , qù wèn zhàng , yìjià . "
pairs.english: “Then you will need a representative of your own choosing to question the accounts and negotiate rates.”
pairs.hanzi: “那就得有你们自己推的人，去问账、议价。”

pairs.target: " gōngzǐ tì wǒmen tiāo ? "
pairs.english: “You'll pick them for us, young master?”
pairs.hanzi: “公子替我们挑？”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu táiqǐ liǎn .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou lifted his face.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟抬起脸。

pairs.target: " nǐmen tiāo .
pairs.english: “You pick.
pairs.hanzi: “你们挑。

pairs.target: zuò dé bùhǎo , yě yóu nǐmen huàn . "
pairs.english: If they do a poor job, it's up to you to replace them too.”
pairs.hanzi: 做得不好，也由你们换。”

pairs.target: " huàn le zhīhòu ne ?
pairs.english: “And after we've replaced them?
pairs.hanzi: “换了之后呢？

pairs.target: xiàhuí pàihuó , jì bu jì zhège rén de zhàng ? "
pairs.english: Next time they assign jobs, will they bear a grudge against that person?”
pairs.hanzi: 下回派活，记不记这个人的账？”

pairs.target: tā tíng le tíng , zài zhǐbiān yòu jì le yìbǐ .
pairs.english: He paused, then made another note along the edge of the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 他停了停，在纸边又记了一笔。

pairs.target: " zhèdiǎn wǒ xiānqián méi xiǎng zhōuquán .
pairs.english: “I didn't think that point through beforehand.
pairs.hanzi: “这点我先前没想周全。

pairs.target: yào ràng rén gǎn kāikǒu , guāng xiě néng huànrén hái búgòu . "
pairs.english: If people are to dare to speak, just writing down that they can replace someone still isn't enough.”
pairs.hanzi: 要让人敢开口，光写能换人还不够。”

pairs.target: guō lǐ de shuǐ qīngqīng xiǎng .
pairs.english: The water murmured softly in the pot.
pairs.hanzi: 锅里的水轻轻响。

pairs.target: lín zhào dītóu róu kāi shǒulǐ de bù , méiyǒu qù jiē tā dehuà .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao looked down, loosening the cloth in her hands, and did not respond to his remarks.
pairs.hanzi: 林照低头揉开手里的布，没有去接他的话。

pairs.target: tā tīngdéchū tā shuō dé rènzhēn , kězhēnyào tuī yígè rén qù , shuíkěn zuò dìyīgè , tā yě bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: She could hear he was serious, but when it came to actually choosing someone to go, she didn't know who would agree to be the first.
pairs.hanzi: 她听得出他说得认真，可真要推一个人去，谁肯做第一个，她也不知道。

pairs.target: xǔ cén jiāng xī shàng de tú fàng dī le xiē .
pairs.english: Xu Cen lowered the map on her knees a little.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑将膝上的图放低了些。

pairs.target: " jiālǐ kěn ? "
pairs.english: “The family agrees?”
pairs.hanzi: “家里肯？”

pairs.target: " hái méi kěn . "
pairs.english: “They haven't yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “还没肯。”

pairs.target: " nà nǐ xiān bǎ zhèxiē dōu xǔ chūqù ? "
pairs.english: “So you are already promising all of this?”
pairs.hanzi: “那你先把这些都许出去？”

pairs.target: " suǒyǐ délái wèn .
pairs.english: “That's why I have to ask.
pairs.hanzi: “所以得来问。

pairs.target: guāng zài wūlǐ xiě qì , xiě bù chū gāngcái nà jǐjùhuà . "
pairs.english: Just sitting in a room writing contracts won't give me what you said a moment ago.”
pairs.hanzi: 光在屋里写契，写不出刚才那几句话。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu bǎ zhǐ wǎng dēng biān nuó le nuó , mò hái shī zhe .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou shifted the paper closer to the lamp; the ink was still wet.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟把纸往灯边挪了挪，墨还湿着。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎng gǎi de , yě bù zhī zhè yìháng .
pairs.english: “And it's not only this one business I want to change.
pairs.hanzi: “我想改的，也不只这一行。

pairs.target: guǎn yíchù cāng , lǐng yíduì rén , gāi kàn shuí néng bǎ shì zuòhǎo .
pairs.english: For running a warehouse or leading a team, we should look at who can do the job well.
pairs.hanzi: 管一处仓、领一队人，该看谁能把事做好。

pairs.target: zuò dé zěnyàng , ràng gēnzhe tā zuòshì de rén yě néng píng , yě néng shuō huàn . "
pairs.english: Let the people who work under them judge how they perform, and have a say in replacing them as well.”
pairs.hanzi: 做得怎样，让跟着他做事的人也能评，也能说换。”

alignment.english: have a say in replacing them

pairs.target: " wǎnghòu xuǎnrèn guǎnshì , ruò néng shǎo kàn xiē méndì , duō wènwèn dǐxià de rén , xǔduō shì jiù búbì děngdào nào dà cái zhīdào .
pairs.english: “When appointing stewards in future, if we consider family background less and consult the people below more, we won't have to wait for so many problems to blow up before we hear of them.
pairs.hanzi: “往后选任管事，若能少看些门第，多问问底下的人，许多事就不必等到闹大才知道。

pairs.target: chénglǐ xiūlù , pài yì , chūlì de rén yě gāi néng zìjǐ tuī rén qù yì , wènqīng qián yòng zài nǎér , rén yòu gāi zěnme pài .
pairs.english: When the city builds roads or levies labor, the workers should also be able to choose a representative themselves to join the deliberations, and ask where the money is going and how the labor ought to be assigned.
pairs.hanzi: 城里修路、派役，出力的人也该能自己推人去议，问清钱用在哪儿，人又该怎么派。

pairs.target: chū le cuò , zuòzài shàngtóu de rén yě dé xiàlái . "
pairs.english: If they get things wrong, the people at the top must step down too.”
pairs.hanzi: 出了错，坐在上头的人也得下来。”

pairs.target: tā wàng zháo huǒpén , bǎ yíkuài méi shāo tòu de tàn fān le gè miàn .
pairs.english: He looked into the brazier and turned over a lump of charcoal that hadn't burned through.
pairs.hanzi: 他望着火盆，把一块没烧透的炭翻了个面。

pairs.target: " rén kěn xué běnshì , yě dé yǒu dìfāng yòng ; zuòdéhǎo de rén duō le , rìzi cáinéng yíchù yichù hǎo qǐlái . "
pairs.english: “People willing to learn skills need a place to use them too; as more people do their work well, life can get better, one place at a time.”
pairs.hanzi: “人肯学本事，也得有地方用；做得好的人多了，日子才能一处一处好起来。”

pairs.target: shào píng kàn le kàn nà zhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: Shao Ping glanced at the sheet of paper.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平看了看那张纸。

pairs.target: " nín jiālǐ pà shì hái dé yì yízhèn . "
pairs.english: “I reckon your family will have to discuss it a while longer.”
pairs.hanzi: “您家里怕是还得议一阵。”

pairs.target: " shì . "
pairs.english: “Yes.”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu xiào le yíxià , jiāng bǐ fàngxià , " yǎnxià xiān bǎ zhèfèn qì gǎi dé néng yòng .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou smiled briefly and put the pen down. “For now, let's make this contract workable.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟笑了一下，将笔放下，“眼下先把这份契改得能用。

pairs.target: nǐmen xiǎngdào shénme , huílái jǐnguǎn zhǎo wǒ shuō . "
pairs.english: If you think of anything, come and tell me when we're back.”
pairs.hanzi: 你们想到什么，回来尽管找我说。”

pairs.target: lín zhào xiǎng wèn , méiyǒu běnqián de zěnme fēn gǔ , huà dào le zuǐbiān , yòu tíngzhù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao wanted to ask how someone without capital could get a share, but the words reached her lips and stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 林照想问，没有本钱的怎么分股，话到了嘴边，又停住。

pairs.target: tā yǐjīng shuō le jiā huó de shì , zài zhuī zhe wèn zìjǐ de fèné , dǎoxiàng zhī tīng jìn le fēnqián liǎng zì .
pairs.english: She had already mentioned the extra work; if she kept pressing about her own share, it would seem she had heard only ‘sharing the money.’
pairs.hanzi: 她已经说了加活的事，再追着问自己的份额，倒像只听进了分钱两字。

pairs.target: tā hái dé kào zhè tàng chāishì de jiàn bǎo lǐng pái , biàn jiāng nà kuài bù zhé hǎo , fàngdào le guō páng .
pairs.english: She still needed a reference from this expedition to get her license, so she folded the cloth and set it beside the pot.
pairs.hanzi: 她还得靠这趟差事的荐保领牌，便将那块布折好，放到了锅旁。

pairs.target: guō lǐ de shuǐfèi qǐlái .
pairs.english: The water in the pot came to a boil.
pairs.hanzi: 锅里的水沸起来。

pairs.target: wēn shù diàn zhe bù tí guō , jiào rén bǎ wǎn ná guòlái , huàtóu biàn sàn le .
pairs.english: Wen Shu lifted the pot with a cloth and asked someone to bring the bowls over; the conversation then drifted off.
pairs.hanzi: 温述垫着布提锅，叫人把碗拿过来，话头便散了。

pairs.target: lín zhào duān zhe rèshuǐ zuòxià , cháo nà zhī bǔguò de xiǎo wǎn suǒzài de fāngxiàng wàng le yìyǎn , gé zhe jǐdào qiáng , shénme yě kànbújiàn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao sat with her hot water and glanced in the direction of that mended little bowl; with several walls between, she could not see anything.
pairs.hanzi: 林照端着热水坐下，朝那只补过的小碗所在的方向望了一眼，隔着几道墙，什么也看不见。

pairs.target: láng wài de shuǐ què hái zài liú , tiānhēi zhīhòu , tīng zhe fǎnér gèng jìn .
pairs.english: Yet the water outside still flowed; after dark it actually sounded closer.
pairs.hanzi: 廊外的水却还在流，天黑之后，听着反而更近。

pairs.target: " xiān wǒ hé dùhéng . "
pairs.english: “Du Heng and I first,”
pairs.hanzi: “先我和杜衡。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu shuō , " hòumiàn zhào lùshang pái de huàn .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou said. “Then rotate as we arranged on the road.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟说，“后面照路上排的换。

pairs.target: bié yígè rén chūqù . "
pairs.english: Don't go out alone.”
pairs.hanzi: 别一个人出去。”

pairs.target: zhòngrén lùxù shōu le dōngxī .
pairs.english: Everyone stowed their gear one after another.
pairs.hanzi: 众人陆续收了东西。

pairs.target: qī lán bǎ cāgān de jiàn zhuāng huí náng lǐ , xǔ cén juǎnqǐ zhǐ , wēn shù jiāng dēng liúzài shímén nèicè .
pairs.english: Qi Lan packed the dried arrows back into her quiver, Xu Cen rolled up the sheet, and Wen Shu left the lamp just inside the stone door.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚把擦干的箭装回囊里，许岑卷起纸，温述将灯留在石门内侧。

pairs.target: dēngguāng zhī zhào chū láng qián yìxiǎopiàn , zài wǎng wài biàn àn le .
pairs.english: The lamplight lit only a small patch in front of the gallery; farther out was darkness.
pairs.hanzi: 灯光只照出廊前一小片，再往外便暗了。

pairs.target: lín zhào tuō xià shī xié , xié jiān cháowài bǎiqí .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao took off her wet shoes and lined them up with the toes pointing out.
pairs.hanzi: 林照脱下湿鞋，鞋尖朝外摆齐。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yāodài sāi zài zhěnbiān , gāng tǎng xià , yòu zuò qǐlái , cóng yījīn lǐ qǔchū zhé le jǐcéng de qìzhǐ .
pairs.english: She tucked her waist pouch beside her pillow; she had barely lain down before sitting up again to take out the contract, folded several times, from inside her jacket.
pairs.hanzi: 她把腰袋塞在枕边，刚躺下，又坐起来，从衣襟里取出折了几层的契纸。

pairs.target: wàimiàn nà céng yǐjīng cháo ruǎn le .
pairs.english: The outer fold had already gone soft with damp.
pairs.hanzi: 外面那层已经潮软了。

pairs.target: tā xiǎoxīn zhǎnkāi , gé zhe dēngguāng liàng le piànkè , cái chóngxīn zhé hǎo , yājìn pūgài lǐmiàn .
pairs.english: She carefully unfolded it, aired it near the lamplight for a moment, then folded it again and tucked it inside the bedding.
pairs.hanzi: 她小心展开，隔着灯光晾了片刻，才重新折好，压进铺盖里面。

pairs.target: mòbǐ shōu zhòng de nàge " zhào " zì , mò huán qīngqīngchǔchǔ , yìdiǎn méi yīn .
pairs.english: The ink of the “Zhao” character with its heavy final stroke was still clear, without a trace of bleeding.
pairs.hanzi: 末笔收重的那个“照”字，墨还清清楚楚，一点没洇。
